card.name: Digits inside week-length numbers
card.fires_on: A digit in the middle of a number that is about to be followed by weeks or days, such as the 3 in 13 weeks, the 5 in 25 days, or the 8 in a 28-day cycle. It fires where the number is part of a dosing interval or cycle length.

modes.label: Interval digits
modes.description: Digit inside a two-digit number giving a dosing interval in days or weeks.

modes.label: Cycle or duration length
modes.description: Digit in a cycle length or study duration measured in weeks or days.

card.writes: It pushes toward the word week and away from month, so the number is read as weeks.
card.plain: It marks a number that is partway typed and likely to be followed by weeks rather than months.
